note: t1250 (handbook §6#119): V5.5 suite, deterministic CREATE2 deploy via the public deterministic deployer. PLAN ONLY: nothing here was signed or sent. Canonical build: work/t1214/contracts (forge 1.10.0, solc 0.8.37, via_ir, optimizer 200, evm cancun; relative remappings, so the bytecode is location independent). The owner's Base Account sends the steps (see src/v5/deploy-v55.mjs deployV55Batches); KipurseKeySeatV2 is per wallet (CREATE2 in each opening batch), not part of this plan.

derivation.vault: adapter.vaultAddress(wallet) = factory.vaultAddress(adapter, wallet, USDC) = EIP-1167 clone of vaultImpl, CREATE2(factory, salt = bytes32(uint256(uint160(wallet))))
derivation.seatV2: CREATE2(deployer, keccak256("kipurse-key-seat-v2"), keccak256(KipurseKeySeatV2.creationCode ‖ abi.encode(cbswFactory, ownerBaseAccount, SPM, trust)))

gas.measuredOn: anvil fork of Base mainnet at block 60907625 (t1250-v55-suite-fork.e2e.mjs, after the §12 vault fix)
gas.note: gasUsed of the deployer txs alone and of the two owner Base Account batches (executeBatch from the EntryPoint v0.6; excludes UserOp verification / preVerification overhead)

steps.label: PayerVaultFactoryV55(entryPoint v0.7, Circle paymaster, paymaster2 = none) - same values as the live V5.3/V5.4 factory
KipurseAdapterV55(SPM, USDC, factoryV55, live fee controller) - its constructor creates KipurseTrustV55 and the shared PayerVaultV55 / KipurseFloatVaultV55 implementations
KipurseMerchantRegistryV2(maintainer = the owner's Base Account, delay 48 h) - same maintainer/delay as the live registry
